cost: Local inference; monetary cost not assigned
interpretation: Integer sums of Fast Agent usage/v2 and retry/v1 telemetry from unique physical live runs, including historical failed attempts. Null means unavailable, never zero. Reported attempts are not an independent network-traffic measurement. Token sums include repeated prompts; cache-read tokens are a subset, not additional prompt tokens. Replay is not new inference. An input without a response does not establish whether a provider request began; its usage is unknown.
